text:
Maya: Quick coordination thread — proposing an early window for the users_v2 schema cutover. Suggested: Tue 01:45-02:45 UTC (avoid peak in APAC). Need owners for canary, backfill, rollback, and smoke.

Ben: I can do rollback and feature-flag flip. Will run the rollback drill before the window.

Olivia: I'll run the backfill. Plan is incremental, per-shard pacing, batch_size=300, sleep_ms=100. Will pause if replica_lag > 3s.

Samir: App routing plan: flip `feature.users_v2` to 5% on canary shard, then 50%, then 100%. I'll coordinate canary rollout and app pool drains.

infra-ontcall: Available for the slot. I'll handle pool drains and keep the replica-lag dashboard open. Ping me 15m before start and I'll post the dashboard link.

QA Lead: I'll run a tiny regression suite against canary traffic and the acceptance smoke SQLs. Need the test users and sample payloads loaded.

Maya: High-level sequence: 
- 01:25 UTC: prechecks (replica lag, free disk, inflight queue <100)
- 01:35 UTC: pre-window rollback drill + feature-flag sanity
- 01:40 UTC: deploy canary backfill job to shard-2 (small set)
- 01:45 UTC: flip `feature.users_v2` to 5% for shard-2 canary
- 01:55 UTC: run smoke SQLs + regression tests
- 02:05 UTC: if green -> ramp to 50% across shards, run concurrent backfills
- 02:25 UTC: final consistency pass, disable dual-write flag
- 02:35 UTC: finalize and monitor for 30m (rollback window ends 03:05 UTC)

Ben: Rollback checklist (short):
1) Set `feature.users_v2` -> 0% immediately (stop routing to new schema)
2) Re-enable writes only to v1 (disable dual-write)
3) Run targeted backfill to catch any missing rows in v1
4) If >0.5% mismatch on sampled keys, escalate and restore from latest snapshot (snap retention: 45m)

Olivia: Canary SQLs (run on shard canary):
```
-- quick null check
SELECT count(*) FROM users_v2 WHERE important_flag IS NULL;
-- recent writes sanity
SELECT count(*) FROM users_v2 WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '5 minutes';
```

Samir: Perf smoke: `SELECT pg_stat_get_backend_pid(), now();` kidding — real check: `SELECT count(*) FROM users_v1 WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '5 minutes';` to ensure writes flowing into v1/v2 during dual-write.

infra-ontcall: Backfill tuning note: start with batch_size=300, sleep_ms=100. If replica lag creeps >3s, reduce to 100 and sleep_ms=200. I'll post live lag numbers.

QA Lead: Test matrix: canary acceptance (~20 critical flows), login, profile update, emb ingestion. I can run these within 8-10 minutes post-canary.

EngManager: Heads-up — ops team scheduled a minor DB vacuum at 03:00 UTC. We must be fully cutover and have the primary checks done before 02:50 to avoid overlap. If we can't, we'll need to reschedule the vacuum.

Maya: Good catch — shifting slightly earlier is fine. Let's lock 01:45-02:45 UTC as final.

Ben: I'll shorten the rollback window to 20 minutes after final check; still will keep extra snapshot in case of restore.

DeployBot: Job scheduled: `deploy/users_v2-cutover` at 2024-11-19T01:45:00Z (CI id: 77213). Logs will post in-thread.

Olivia: A note about downstream consumers: subscriber workers will read from v2 during dual-write. I've added a consumer compatibility check to the canary list.

Maya: Action items:
- Olivia: publish backfill runbook + consumer compat checklist
- Ben: run rollback drill + prepare snapshot plan
- Samir & infra-ontcall: app drains + dashboard link (post 15m before)
- QA Lead: prep regression suite and test users
- Maya: run final sampling and latency checks post-cutover

Please react :white_check_mark: if you ack or flag conflicts. If no objections by EOD today I'll lock the invite and notify ops about the vacuum conflict.
